// diagnostic

E1313

`` `{arg}` doesn't implement `{trait_name}` `` — a trait-bounded variadic call-site argument fails one of the bound trait(s).

What

`` `{arg}` doesn't implement `{trait_name}` `` — a trait-bounded variadic call-site argument fails one of the bound trait(s).

Why

`{param}: ...{trait_name}` (or `...[A, B]`) checks every argument against the bound trait(s) — that's how a function like this accepts a mix of types safely, with each argument monomorphized to its own concrete type (zero boxing).

Fix

Implement `{trait_name}` for the argument's type, or drop the value from this call.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1313: tests/ui/variadic_trait_bound_unmet.stderr.

Error [jet.VariadicBoundNotImplemented]: `fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!` doesn't implement `Renderable`
  --> tests/ui/variadic_trait_bound_unmet.jet:9:16
    |
  9 |     log_all(1, double)
    |                ^^^^^^
 Why: `parts: ...Renderable` checks every argument against `Renderable` — that's how `log_all` accepts a mix of types safely
 Fix: Implement `Renderable` for `fn(Int) -[]> Int Never!`'s type, or drop the value from this call
